title: create a CLAUDE.md equivalent to the one in the parent directory
description:
We need to extract from the parent directory a CLAUDE.md that contains
rules applicable to the public spoons (those not used by me).

Any information specific to my configuration (e.g. directories,
and my own local commands) should not be included in it.

Also, CLAUDE.md should make sure that claude does not finish a bead
until it gets human approval (unless explicitly stated that this approval
is not required)
acceptance_criteria: User will approve the bead as completed.
close_reason: CLAUDE.md written for public Spoons; AGENTS.md symlinked; approved by user

title: create a spoon to communicate with yabai and give hs2 the ability to control spaces
description:
the yabai fork of MacOS27

https://github.com/Christian-SC26/yabai/releases

provides a command line method to have spaces control

We need to install it, and create a spoon to communicate to it using its socket
(not its command line).
